t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup drawn as an engineering drawing sheet on deep navy, framed by a hairline border with zone numbers along the top and bottom and zone letters down the sides. A large light-weight limestone sans headline across the top. Below, a boxed hairline register table with a narrow column of mono row numbers and underscore document codes and a wide column of names for <CONTENT>. An empty gridded title block in the bottom-right corner, one muted steel-blue accent bar. Flat, square corners, calm.
signature_idea: The review scope is set as a drawing register on a zone-bordered navy sheet, each area carrying a mono document code.

light headline and mono codes fit the brand pairing
easy to build with CSS borders and tokens
weaknesses: plain table only, no visual idea beyond the frame
steel-blue bars and the line crossing row 03 mean nothing

brand_fit_why: Navy, limestone, steel-blue accent, light headline, mono codes and square corners fit, but the meaningless accent bars and empty frame add little.
